title: Chapter 13 bankruptcy - basics
facts: Chapter 13 allows an eligible individual with regular income to propose a court-supervised repayment plan while generally keeping property.
A Chapter 13 plan generally runs three to five years depending on applicable rules and circumstances.
Chapter 13 can allow a debtor to cure certain arrears over time and may provide protections not available in the same way under Chapter 7.
A Chapter 13 discharge generally comes after completion of required plan payments and other statutory requirements.
